---
title: "VAE Embedding (Lite)"
subtitle: "Single configuration (beta=0.001), average ensemble, thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Train a 6-dimensional regularized VAE with beta=0.001 using 5-fold stratified cross-validation for thresholds 7 and 8, then compute average ensemble coordinates across folds.

## Configuration

```{r}
#| label: config

LATENT_DIM <- 6
N_FOLDS <- 5
BATCH_SIZE <- 256
EPOCHS <- 150
PATIENCE <- 40
BETA <- 0.001
THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)
```

## Setup

### Python Environment

Select the Python environment that provides keras3 and TensorFlow. The environment is not
hard-coded: set `VAE_VIRTUALENV` or `RETICULATE_PYTHON` to point at your own.

```{r}
#| label: python-setup

Sys.setenv(TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS = "0")
Sys.setenv(TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH = "true")

library(reticulate)

# Resolution order, first match wins:
#   1. VAE_VIRTUALENV    name or path of a virtualenv (this project's knob)
#   2. RETICULATE_PYTHON path to a python binary (reticulate honours this itself)
#   3. reticulate's default discovery
# Set one in your shell or in a local .Renviron. requirements.txt pins the
# versions this analysis was run with.
vae_virtualenv <- Sys.getenv("VAE_VIRTUALENV", unset = "")

if (nzchar(vae_virtualenv)) {

  if (!virtualenv_exists(vae_virtualenv)) {
    stop(
      "VAE_VIRTUALENV is set to '", vae_virtualenv, "' but no virtualenv is there.\n",
      "  Create it:  python3 -m venv ", vae_virtualenv, "\n",
      "              ", vae_virtualenv, "/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt\n",
      "  Or unset VAE_VIRTUALENV and set RETICULATE_PYTHON to a python that\n",
      "  already provides tensorflow.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  use_virtualenv(vae_virtualenv, required = TRUE)

} else if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("RETICULATE_PYTHON"))) {

  message(
    "Neither VAE_VIRTUALENV nor RETICULATE_PYTHON is set; using reticulate's\n",
    "default Python discovery. If this selects the wrong interpreter, set\n",
    "VAE_VIRTUALENV to a virtualenv built from requirements.txt."
  )

}
```

```{r}

gpu_available <- length(gpu_devices) > 0
```

**Environment:**

- **Python:** `r py_config()$python`
- **TensorFlow:** `r as.character(tf_version())`
- **GPU available:** `r ifelse(gpu_available, "Yes", "No")`
- **Device:** `r if(gpu_available) gpu_devices[[1]]$name else "CPU only"`

::: {.callout-warning}
The published latent coordinates were produced on a CUDA 12 GPU with TensorFlow 2.20.0.
Fixed seeds plus `enable_op_determinism()` reproduce the fit bit-for-bit on the same GPU —
verified byte-identical across TensorFlow 2.20 and 2.21, so a minor TensorFlow upgrade is
safe. What does rotate the basis is a change of *hardware*: a CPU run, or a different GPU or
CUDA build, yields the same trajectory structure on rotated axes, whose latent dimension
indices are not comparable across runs.
:::

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

load_threshold_data <- function(threshold) {
  file_path <- here(glue(
    "data/collaborator_only/adjusted_meth/adjusted_methylation_scaled_nlog10p_gte_{threshold}.rds"
  ))

  data <- read_rds(file_path)

  meth_matrix <- data |>
    select(starts_with("cg")) |>
    as.matrix()

  list(
    matrix = meth_matrix,
    demcat = data$demcat,
    subject_id = data$subject_id,
    n_subjects = nrow(meth_matrix),
    n_features = ncol(meth_matrix),
    threshold = threshold
  )
}

datasets <- map(THRESHOLDS, load_threshold_data) |>
  set_names(glue("threshold_{THRESHOLDS}"))

walk2(names(datasets), datasets, \(nm, ds) {
  message(glue("{nm}: {ds$n_subjects} subjects, {ds$n_features} features"))
})
```

## VAE Architecture

```{r}
#| label: define-vae-model

create_improved_regularized_vae <- function(input_dim, latent_dim = 6, beta = 0.001) {

  # Sampling layer for reparameterization trick
  sampling_layer <- new_layer_class(
    classname = "Sampling",
    call = function(inputs, mask = NULL) {
      z_mean <- inputs[[1]]
      z_log_var <- inputs[[2]]
      batch_size <- op_shape(z_mean)[1]
      dim <- op_shape(z_mean)[2]
      epsilon <- random_normal(shape = c(batch_size, dim), dtype = "float32")
      z_mean + op_exp(0.5 * z_log_var) * epsilon
    }
  )

  # Encoder: Input -> 512 -> 256 -> 128 -> 64 -> (z_mean, z_log_var)
  encoder_input <- layer_input(shape = input_dim, name = "encoder_input")

  h <- encoder_input |>
    layer_dense(units = 512, name = "encoder_dense1") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "encoder_bn1") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "encoder_relu1") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.05, name = "encoder_dropout1") |>
    layer_dense(units = 256, name = "encoder_dense2") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "encoder_bn2") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "encoder_relu2") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.05, name = "encoder_dropout2") |>
    layer_dense(units = 128, name = "encoder_dense3") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "encoder_bn3") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "encoder_relu3") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.05, name = "encoder_dropout3") |>
    layer_dense(units = 64, name = "encoder_dense4") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "encoder_bn4") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "encoder_relu4") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.1, name = "encoder_dropout4")

  z_mean <- h |> layer_dense(units = latent_dim, name = "z_mean")
  z_log_var <- h |> layer_dense(units = latent_dim, name = "z_log_var")

  encoder_model <- keras_model(
    inputs = encoder_input,
    outputs = list(z_mean, z_log_var),
    name = "encoder"
  )

  # Decoder: 6D latent -> 64 -> 128 -> 256 -> 512 -> Output
  decoder_input <- layer_input(shape = latent_dim, name = "decoder_input")

  decoder_output <- decoder_input |>
    layer_dense(units = 64, name = "decoder_dense1") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "decoder_bn1") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "decoder_relu1") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.1, name = "decoder_dropout1") |>
    layer_dense(units = 128, name = "decoder_dense2") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "decoder_bn2") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "decoder_relu2") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.05, name = "decoder_dropout2") |>
    layer_dense(units = 256, name = "decoder_dense3") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "decoder_bn3") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "decoder_relu3") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.05, name = "decoder_dropout3") |>
    layer_dense(units = 512, name = "decoder_dense4") |>
    layer_batch_normalization(name = "decoder_bn4") |>
    layer_activation("relu", name = "decoder_relu4") |>
    layer_dropout(rate = 0.05, name = "decoder_dropout4") |>
    layer_dense(units = input_dim, activation = "linear", name = "output_layer")

  decoder_model <- keras_model(
    inputs = decoder_input,
    outputs = decoder_output,
    name = "decoder"
  )

  # VAE model class with custom loss
  vae_class <- new_model_class(
    classname = "ImprovedRegularizedVAE",
    initialize = function(encoder, decoder, beta = 0.001, ...) {
      super$initialize(...)
      self$encoder <- encoder
      self$decoder <- decoder
      self$beta <- beta
    },

    call = function(inputs, training = NULL, mask = NULL) {
      encoder_output <- self$encoder(inputs)
      z_mean <- encoder_output[[1]]
      z_log_var <- encoder_output[[2]]
      z <- sampling_layer(list(z_mean, z_log_var))
      reconstruction <- self$decoder(z)

      kl_loss <- -0.5 * op_mean(
        op_sum(1 + z_log_var - op_square(z_mean) - op_exp(z_log_var), axis = 1L)
      )
      self$add_loss(self$beta * kl_loss)

      reconstruction
    }
  )

  vae <- vae_class(encoder = encoder_model, decoder = decoder_model, beta = beta)

  vae$build(shape(NULL, input_dim))
  vae |>
    compile(
      optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.001),
      loss = loss_mean_squared_error(),
      metrics = list(metric_mean_squared_error())
    )

  list(
    vae = vae,
    encoder = encoder_model,
    decoder = decoder_model,
    beta = beta
  )
}
```

## Cross-Validation Training

```{r}
#| label: define-training-function

train_vae_cv <- function(data, beta, n_folds = 5, batch_size = 256, epochs = 150, patience = 40) {

  meth_matrix <- data$matrix
  demcat <- data$demcat

  set.seed(123)
  cv_splits <- vfold_cv(
    tibble(idx = 1:nrow(meth_matrix), demcat = demcat),
    v = n_folds,
    strata = demcat
  )

  cv_results <- list()

  for (fold_idx in 1:n_folds) {
    tensorflow::set_random_seed(123 + fold_idx)

    fold_split <- cv_splits$splits[[fold_idx]]
    train_idx <- as.integer(fold_split, data = "analysis")
    test_idx <- as.integer(fold_split, data = "assessment")

    x_train <- meth_matrix[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    x_test <- meth_matrix[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    vae_models <- create_improved_regularized_vae(
      input_dim = ncol(meth_matrix),
      latent_dim = LATENT_DIM,
      beta = beta
    )

    callbacks <- list(
      callback_early_stopping(
        monitor = "val_loss",
        patience = patience,
        restore_best_weights = TRUE,
        verbose = 0
      ),
      callback_reduce_lr_on_plateau(
        monitor = "val_loss",
        patience = 20,
        factor = 0.5,
        min_lr = 1e-5,
        verbose = 0
      )
    )

    history <- vae_models$vae |>
      fit(
        x = x_train,
        y = x_train,
        epochs = epochs,
        batch_size = batch_size,
        validation_data = list(x_test, x_test),
        callbacks = callbacks,
        verbose = 0
      )

    # Get latent representations (z_mean)
    encoder_output <- vae_models$encoder(tf$constant(meth_matrix, dtype = "float32"))
    z_mean <- as.matrix(encoder_output[[1]])

    latent_coords <- as_tibble(z_mean) |>
      set_names(paste0("dim", 1:LATENT_DIM)) |>
      mutate(
        subject_id = data$subject_id,
        demcat = demcat,
        fold = fold_idx
      )

    cv_results[[fold_idx]] <- list(
      fold = fold_idx,
      latent_coords = latent_coords
    )
  }

  cv_results
}
```

### Train and Save

```{r}
#| label: train-and-save

for (threshold in THRESHOLDS) {
  threshold_name <- glue("threshold_{threshold}")
  data <- datasets[[threshold_name]]

  tictoc::tic(glue("Training VAE: Threshold {threshold}, Beta = {BETA}"))

  cv_results <- train_vae_cv(
    data = data,
    beta = BETA,
    n_folds = N_FOLDS,
    batch_size = BATCH_SIZE,
    epochs = EPOCHS,
    patience = PATIENCE
  )

  tictoc::toc()

  # Average ensemble: mean of latent coords across folds
  all_coords <- map_dfr(cv_results, "latent_coords")

  embedding <- all_coords |>
    summarise(
      across(starts_with("dim"), mean),
      .by = c(subject_id, demcat)
    ) |>
    rename_with(\(x) str_replace(x, "^dim", "vae_"), starts_with("dim"))

  write_rds(
    embedding,
    here(output_dir, glue("embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds"))
  )

  message(glue("Saved: embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds ({nrow(embedding)} subjects)"))
}
```

## Verify Outputs

```{r}
#| label: verify

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(threshold) {
  emb <- read_rds(here(output_dir, glue("embedding_threshold_{threshold}.rds")))
  message(glue("Threshold {threshold}: {nrow(emb)} rows, {ncol(emb)} cols"))
  message(glue("  Columns: {paste(names(emb), collapse = ', ')}"))
  message(glue("  Demcat levels: {paste(unique(emb$demcat), collapse = ', ')}"))
})
```
